variants.headline: Still in view: party names a new leader
variants.sub: Leadership of {party} has changed, with {new} the new leader.
variants.body:
The party {party} has a new leader: {new}. Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement.

The gazette records the change of party leadership without presuming the circumstances in which it occurred. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.

variants.headline: Still in view: leadership changes hands
variants.body:
Leadership of {party} has changed, with {new} the new leader. This story remains under examination, {months_running} months into our coverage of the original event.

The gazette records the change of party leadership without presuming the circumstances in which it occurred. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.
